format: C++/Python hybrid (C++ source with embedded Python C API functions)
description: Source code for signal handling and worker process management in PyTorch's DataLoader, including signal handlers for SIGBUS, SIGSEGV, SIGFPE, and SIGTERM, as well as functions to set and check worker process statuses.

methods.name: setSignalHandler
methods.description: Configures a signal handler for a specific signal using sigaction.

methods.name: handler_SIGBUS
methods.description: Signal handler for SIGBUS errors in worker processes.

methods.name: handler_SIGSEGV
methods.description: Signal handler for SIGSEGV errors in worker processes.

methods.name: handler_SIGFPE
methods.description: Signal handler for floating point exceptions in worker processes.

methods.name: handler_SIGTERM
methods.description: Signal handler for SIGTERM to gracefully exit worker processes.

methods.name: setDataLoaderSignalHandlers
methods.description: Weakly linked function to set additional DataLoader signal handlers.

methods.name: THPModule_setWorkerSignalHandlers
methods.description: Sets signal handlers for worker processes via Python C API.

methods.name: THPModule_errorIfAnyWorkerFails
methods.description: Checks worker process statuses and raises errors if any have failed or been killed.

methods.name: THPModule_setWorkerPIDs
methods.description: Records worker process IDs for monitoring.

methods.name: THPModule_removeWorkerPIDs
methods.description: Removes worker process IDs from monitoring.
